item.title: github: Copilot code review: Adaptive effort, secret detection, and more
item.description:
GitHub Copilot code review now supports adaptive review depth, so routine pull requests get a lighter pass while more complex ones receive deeper review. The update also adds secret detection and other improvements.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Purpose-built model for leaked secret detection
item.description:
GitHub announced a new purpose-built, context-aware model for leaked secret detection as part of Secret Protection. It is intended to improve secret detection in code workflows, including those that involve AI agents.

  • Source: GitHub
